errors.evidence: The description fails to explain what each of the two lines represents according to the legend. While it identifies the lines by color (blue and orange), it omits that the blue line represents 'GDP per man-hour at current prices' (БВП на един отработен човекочас по текущи цени) and the orange line represents 'GDP per man-hour at 2015 prices' (БВП на един отработен човекочас по цени на 2015 г.). This is a critical omission as it is the main point of comparison in the chart.
